infoCards.title: Inventory Control
infoCards.description: Real-time inventory tracking and stock management system.

faqData.question: How does the system handle multi-store operations?
faqData.answer: Our system provides comprehensive multi-store management including centralized inventory control, inter-store transfers, consolidated reporting and real-time synchronization across all locations.

faqData.question: What POS and payment features are included?
faqData.answer: The system includes advanced POS functionality with multiple payment methods, split payments, returns processing, gift cards and integrated payment security compliance.

faqData.question: Can it manage e-commerce integration?
faqData.answer: Yes, our solution provides seamless e-commerce integration with real-time inventory sync, unified customer profiles, omnichannel order fulfillment and integrated loyalty programs.
